text.formatted: The goblin makes two attacks, using Scimitar or Shortbow in any combination.
text.plain: The goblin makes two attacks, using Scimitar or Shortbow in any combination.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +4, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.

text.formatted: _Ranged Attack Roll:_ +4, range 80/320 ft. _Hit:_ 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
text.plain: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.

text.formatted: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.
text.plain: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

text.formatted: _Trigger:_ A creature the goblin can see makes an attack roll against it. _Response:_ The goblin chooses a Small or Medium ally within 5 feet of itself. The goblin and that ally swap places, and the ally becomes the target of the attack instead.
text.plain: Trigger: A creature the goblin can see makes an attack roll against it. Response: The goblin chooses a Small or Medium ally within 5 feet of itself. The goblin and that ally swap places, and the ally becomes the target of the attack instead.
